title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the magnitude of the Ampere force on rod M as F = (B²L²v₀)/(2R).

title: Ampere force direction
description: Essential: The answer must state the direction of the Ampere force on rod M as horizontally to the left.

title: Charge calculation
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must give the charge as q = mv₀/(3BL).

title: Minimum distance x
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must give the minimum distance as x = (2mv₀R)/(3B²L²).

title: Range for k
description: Essential: The answer for part (4) must state the range for k as 2 ≤ k < 3.

title: Applying impulse theorem
description: Important: The solution must apply the impulse theorem (BILΔt = mΔv) to relate force to momentum change for at least one rod.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the circuit, using Ohm's law (I = E/(2R)) and motional EMF (E = BLv).

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: For parts (2)-(4), the solution must apply conservation of momentum to the two-rod system.

title: Charge via average current
description: Optional: The solution may derive the charge by relating it to the average current and change in magnetic flux or rod displacement.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of the Ampere force, induced current, or rod motion is incorrectly assigned.

title: Incorrect circuit resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the total circuit resistance is not treated as 2R (sum of both rod resistances).
